introduction: Explore the Rift Valley Jungle floor, canopy, bullywug village, lizardman caves, Moonhollow and elemental cages. Twelve story outcomes and twelve supply services classify all twenty-eight exchanges, with three non-credit referrals or rejections. Active, ready accounting is required. Current possession does not prove personal recovery; dialogue, access, effects and combined campaigns need separate accepted events.
orientation: The three Woodseer approaches enter the western jungle; the southeastern trail connects to the current surface. Climb the actual tree routes for canopy sources. Connected load rooms seed wandering actors; a declared load location is not a guaranteed current position. River currents, falls, closed routes and actual movement rules remain relevant. Some exact proofs are secret items: search the source room or opened source container as appropriate. Revealing an item, acquiring it, and handing it in are different events.

Meet recipients before asking addressed words. Dialogue topics explain requests but do not award keyword achievements. Twelve flagged contacts receive generic class-sensitive teacher level guidance; the schoolteacher's name alone does not confer that runtime role. The two bartenders also offer separate procedural world quests.

For the elderly couatl, recover three eggs of the same exact kind from the scattered placement sites, plus the drow hunter's wrist guard. Offer all four loose items together for a burnished bracer. The young couatl returns an egg kind and refers you to the elder; that optional referral earns no separate credit and does not prove the same physical egg survived.

Reiwiggy offers three paid services: two giant-alligator skins for a tunic, two red-alligator skins for armor, or two ordinary tiger skins for tiger armor, each with ten platinum. These mixed payments are currently guarded with accounting active. He refuses white skin; the cave leather-worker accepts it for boots without requiring the refusal first.

Enter the lizardman caves through their actual hidden closed routes. Soft bark becomes a blanket service; canopy red petals finish the painter's pigment request; the strange parchment supplies the engineer. The plans actually load in Moonhollow guard quarters despite his cave clue. No mural or city construction is recorded by delivery.

The cave leather-worker also needs three red-alligator and three giant-alligator skins together for three azurian-hide pieces. Its reward name does not mean azurian hide is an input. The tribal shaman turns leaves into a green potion and dartfrog skin into poison; these services do not prove healing or poisoning a target.

The chief's dialogue asks for Summerstorm's head but accepts his silver amulet, which has a forty-percent load roll. The scout asks for the chief's head but accepts his golden rod, which has a thirty-percent equip roll, and rejects the actual mangled head. The opposing requests are independent; no allegiance lock, raid, kill history or peace finale is enforced.

Recover the crystal-headed staff from the Moonhollow lieutenant and bring it to the woodcarver at his unfinished carving for the crystalline bow. The crystal dragon has an equivalent recipient contract but no active appearance or transformation. Use the reachable woodcarver branch; neither two deliveries nor a recorded transformation is required.

The elemental ranger carries four distinct amulets and can wander out of his connected load room toward the jungle or the separate fire, water, air and earth planes. Recover the actual proofs; his equipped flaming javelin is different from the required flaming medallion. Do not assume he remains in the staging room.

The jungle brazier at 80061 leads UP to the fire cage; the water bowl at 80072 leads UP to water; the mud bowl at 80071 leads UP to earth. Each cage has its DOWN return portal. ENTER the plane of light at 80060 for air, and ENTER its paired plane to return. Portal arrival and survival are not current story steps.

Each elemental accepts its own amulet, gives its own reward and leaves: fire javelin, water drums, air cloak, earth mask. These are four independent outcomes. No recorded relocation to its home plane or combined four-rescue finale is implemented. The decorative iron amulet's four compartments have no native opening recipe.

Teglaron offers four five-platinum services: elder hide → armor; young hide → boots and eyepatch; rare mithril ore → hammer; giant-turtle shell → plate armor. All four mixed payments are currently guarded with accounting active. Killing the elder for hide is not a prerequisite to helping him recover eggs.

The elderly weaver needs five green, five yellow and five red quetzel feathers together for her cloak. Green and yellow stock is on different bright-quetzel instances; red comes from red quetzels. Fifteen loose items exceed the current exchange limit of fourteen, so this story is guarded and has no daily candidate until the complete batch can settle safely.

Recover the ancient silver sword from the chieftain's aid and bring it to wandering Mistwalker for Orcslayer and twenty-five platinum. His ghostly reunion is native narrative; recipient departure does not record a spawned ghost, escort or actual effect. Supplied exact sword fits without personal acquisition history.

Moonhollow's tavern memorial, bereaved villagers, school, songs, Windstrider recipes and Teglaron's fused wall axe explain the world without native quest endpoints. Ordinary shop stock, trophy keys and loot remain separate. Five route descriptions now match their actual exits in a separate repair; ambiguous plot or stock decisions remain pending.

Seventeen native recipes retain potential daily shape; classifying services and the staff alternatives leaves eleven authored story candidates. The feather batch and seven mixed payments remain guarded. Repeat availability depends on real encounters, access, stock, retiring recipients, reset mode two and active, ready accounting. No first-source recovery, learned word or whole-jungle campaign is inferred.

Possession does not distinguish your own source recovery from a player handoff. This is a secret item. Search the source room or an opened source container as appropriate before recovery; a successful reveal is separate from acquiring it.

Completion records the successful exchange. Carrying the materials does not complete it or prove finding them yourself. This item-and-coin recipe is currently guarded with accounting active; item readiness does not pay its fee or promise acceptance.

stories.title: Finish the quetzel feather cloak
stories.summary: Bring five green, five yellow and five red quetzel feathers together for a cloak. These are three distinct kinds, not fifteen interchangeable feathers. The fifteen-item recipe is currently guarded under active accounting; the complete exchange must be supported before it becomes available as a daily quest.

steps.text: Carry 5 copies of green quetzel feather
steps.hint: Green quetzel feathers are given to three of the bright-quetzel loads in the connected canopy staging room. The long descriptions and green alias distinguish the otherwise identically named feathers. Possession does not distinguish your own source recovery from a player handoff.

steps.text: Carry 5 copies of yellow quetzel feather
steps.hint: Yellow quetzel feathers are given to two bright-quetzel loads in the connected canopy staging room. Green and yellow come from different instances of the same bird prototype, not every bird. Possession does not distinguish your own source recovery from a player handoff.

steps.text: Carry 5 copies of red quetzel feather
steps.hint: Red quetzel feathers are given to the red-quetzel loads in the connected canopy staging room. Five red, five green and five yellow loose items are required together: fifteen roots exceed the current exchange limit of fourteen. Possession does not distinguish your own source recovery from a player handoff.

Completion records the successful exchange. Carrying the materials does not complete it or prove finding them yourself. The fifteen-item batch is currently guarded by the fourteen-item exchange limit; the journal does not split or reduce the native recipe.

stories.title: Mistwalker's ancient elven sword
stories.summary: Recover the ancient silver sword worn by the chieftain's aid and bring it to wandering Mistwalker for Orcslayer and twenty-five platinum. His story describes a ghostly reunion, but the accepted exchange proves delivery and his departure, not a spawned ghost or completed escort.

steps.hint: The chieftain's aid wears this ancient silver sword in the lizardman throne room. Recover it loose and bring it to wandering Mistwalker. Other silver, green or named swords do not substitute. Possession does not distinguish your own source recovery from a player handoff.

Completion records the successful exchange. Carrying the materials does not complete it or prove finding them yourself. The recipient leaves after the exchange. Repeating it depends on the recipient and fresh supplies becoming available.

stories.title: The angry scout's proof
stories.summary: Bring the lizardman chief's golden rod for a gold leaf; the scout leaves. His dialogue asks for a head but explicitly rejects the mangled head and returns that same kind. The rod is the actual proof, independent of the chief's opposing request.

steps.text: Carry golden rod of the lizardman chieftain
steps.hint: The lizardman chief has a thirty-percent equip roll for this golden rod. The angry scout asks for a head, but accepts this rod. The separate bloody, mangled head is explicitly rejected and returned. Possession does not distinguish your own source recovery from a player handoff.

Completion records the successful exchange. Carrying the materials does not complete it or prove finding them yourself. The recipient leaves after the exchange. Repeating it depends on the recipient and fresh supplies becoming available.

exclusions.reason: Young-couatl referral returns the same egg kind. It is guidance for the elder, not a separate achievement or daily quest.
Reiwiggy explicitly refuses white-tiger skin and returns the same kind. Refusal is not a completed craft or a story achievement.
The angry scout refuses the mangled head and returns the same kind. The golden rod is the distinct accepted story proof; rejection earns no credit.
